payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including empirical evidence, filtering criteria, and error rates.

claims.text: The dataset creation methodology includes empirical evidence of data quality.
Samples are filtered by sentence lengths to improve data quality.
Word error rate (WER) and character error rate (CER) are used as metrics for evaluating model performance on the dataset.
Validated transcripts were sent to professional translators to ensure quality.
